newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Napocor seeks Fort Bonifacio power pact.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Napocor seeks Fort Bonifacio power pact.

text.p: State-run National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Monday it is offering a power sales agreement to the Bases Conversion Development Authority (Basecon) for its Fort Bonifacio conversion project in Makati City.

In a statement on Monday, Napocor president Guido Delgado said it is willing to supply all the 700-megawatt requirements of the Fort Bonifacio project. Basecon is the government agency handling the privatisation of former military sites including Fort Bonifacio, an army camp at the edge of Makati City now being built into a business district.

While the Napocor is the biggest producer of power in the country, the utility has faced competition with independent power producers who built power generation facilities to help solve the power crisis in 1993.
"If you find any supplier with rates lower than our quotations, we accept the challenge to match their rates," Delgado said in a letter to Basecon.
Delgado said Napocor is negotiating with other special economic zones for similar bulk power sales agreement.
